profiles.Summary: Forza Horizon 5 is a demanding open-world racing title that runs on the Steam Deck with some effort — the RDNA 2 GPU sits just below the game's recommended spec, so lower settings and FSR are needed to reach a stable frame rate. ProtonDB reporters rate it gold, meaning it runs with minor tweaks, though the game's DirectX 12 / Xbox ecosystem can introduce occasional issues under Proton.
profiles.BasisNote: No Deck-specific player reports were available; profiles are estimated from the PC minimum/recommended requirements versus Steam Deck GPU capability and ProtonDB gold-tier compatibility. On first run, check frame rate in the Guanajuato festival area (the busiest scene) and adjust the preset down or FSR source resolution lower if frame rate is unstable.

MaxBattery.Notes: Render at 960x600 with FSR upscaling to reduce GPU load significantly; the 8 W TDP and capped GPU clock keep thermals and fan noise low for long sessions. Expect occasional dips below 30 fps in dense traffic or festival areas.

Shader compilation stutters are common on first play session; subsequent sessions are smoother.
HDR has no effect on the Steam Deck LCD panel and should be left disabled.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Running unconstrained at 15 W pushes the Deck to its thermal ceiling and will engage the fan at full speed; expect 40-50 fps with dips in crowded festival areas. Drop to the Optimal profile if sustained stutters appear — 60 fps native is not achievable on this hardware.

Optimal.Notes: The 40 Hz refresh rate / 40 fps lock is the sweet spot on OLED, delivering smooth, tear-free racing with a moderate TDP; FSR at 1024x640 recovers visual sharpness while keeping the GPU within budget.

KnownIssues: Online multiplayer and Xbox Live features may require additional sign-in steps or fail to connect under Proton.
The game uses DirectX 12, which can cause shader compilation stutters on first launch and in new areas.
HDR output may not function correctly under Proton/Linux despite the Steam Deck OLED's HDR capability.
Anti-cheat (ForzaAC) may intermittently cause issues in online modes under Proton.

MaxPerformance.Notes: Running at full 15W TDP with GPU at max clock squeezes the most out of the hardware; expect frame rate dips into the high 30s during dense festival areas or storms, and thermal throttling after extended sessions.
